title: Agent Middleware Components
summary: This module provides a collection of middleware components designed to enhance agent functionality by managing execution, context, tools, and security. It includes features for resource limiting, error handling, human oversight, data privacy, and specialized tooling for various LLM providers.

nodes.label: Codex Sandbox Execution
nodes.title: Codex Sandbox Execution Policy
nodes.description: Executes shell commands within a secure Codex CLI sandbox, applying syscall and filesystem restrictions for enhanced isolation.

nodes.label: Docker Container Execution
nodes.title: Docker Container Execution Policy
nodes.description: Runs shell commands inside dedicated Docker containers, providing strong isolation, resource limits, and configurable security features.

nodes.label: Detect Credit Card Numbers
nodes.title: Credit Card Detection Utility
nodes.description: Identifies potential credit card numbers in text content using regular expressions and Luhn algorithm validation.

nodes.label: Context Editing & Pruning
nodes.title: Context Editing Middleware
nodes.description: Manages conversation context size by automatically pruning tool results and messages based on token count thresholds and configurable editing strategies.

nodes.label: Filesystem File Search Tools
nodes.title: Filesystem File Search Middleware
nodes.description: Provides `glob_search` and `grep_search` tools for efficient file pattern matching and content searching on the local filesystem.

nodes.label: Human Approval for Actions
nodes.title: Human-in-the-Loop Middleware
nodes.description: Introduces human intervention points for agent actions, allowing users to review, approve, edit, or reject tool calls before execution.

nodes.label: Model Call Limiting
nodes.title: Model Call Limit Middleware
nodes.description: Monitors and enforces limits on the number of LLM calls per thread or run, with options to terminate execution or raise errors.

nodes.label: Model Fallback Strategy
nodes.title: Model Fallback Middleware
nodes.description: Automatically retries failed model calls with a sequence of alternative language models, enhancing agent resilience to errors.

nodes.label: Model Call Retries
nodes.title: Model Retry Middleware
nodes.description: Implements automatic retry logic with configurable exponential backoff for failed model calls, improving robustness.

nodes.label: PII Detection & Handling
nodes.title: PII Middleware
nodes.description: Detects and handles Personally Identifiable Information (PII) in agent messages, applying strategies like redaction, masking, or blocking.

nodes.label: Persistent Shell Tool
nodes.title: Shell Tool Middleware
nodes.description: Registers a persistent shell tool for agents, enabling command execution in isolated environments with configurable security policies and output redaction.

nodes.label: Conversation Summarization
nodes.title: Summarization Middleware
nodes.description: Optimizes conversation history by summarizing older messages when token limits are approached, maintaining context while reducing length.

nodes.label: Task List Management
nodes.title: Todo List Middleware
nodes.description: Provides agents with a `write_todos` tool to create and manage structured task lists, aiding in complex multi-step operations and planning.

nodes.label: Write Todo List
nodes.title: Write Todos Function
nodes.description: A tool function that allows the agent to update its internal state with a structured list of tasks (todos).

nodes.label: Async Write Todo List
nodes.title: Async Write Todos Function
nodes.description: Asynchronous wrapper for the `write_todos` tool function, enabling non-blocking updates to the agent's task list.

nodes.label: Tool Call Limiting
nodes.title: Tool Call Limit Middleware
nodes.description: Enforces limits on the number of tool calls per thread or run, providing control over agent resource usage and preventing excessive tool invocation.

nodes.label: LLM Tool Emulation
nodes.title: LLM Tool Emulator
nodes.description: Simulates tool execution using an LLM to generate responses, allowing for testing and development without actual tool invocation.

nodes.label: Tool Call Retries
nodes.title: Tool Retry Middleware
nodes.description: Adds automatic retry logic with exponential backoff for failed tool calls, improving the reliability of agent interactions with external systems.

nodes.label: LLM Tool Selection
nodes.title: LLM Tool Selector Middleware
nodes.description: Uses an LLM to intelligently select the most relevant tools for a given query, optimizing tool usage and reducing token consumption.

nodes.label: Async Middleware Wrapper
nodes.title: Async Middleware Wrapper
nodes.description: An internal utility function for asynchronously wrapping middleware methods, ensuring proper execution within the agent framework.

nodes.label: Sync Middleware Wrapper
nodes.title: Sync Middleware Wrapper
nodes.description: An internal utility function for synchronously wrapping middleware methods, ensuring proper execution within the agent framework.

nodes.label: Claude State Text Editor
nodes.title: Claude State Text Editor Middleware
nodes.description: Provides Anthropic's `text_editor` tool, storing file content within the LangGraph state for persistent conversation-specific files.

nodes.label: Claude State Memory Tool
nodes.title: Claude State Memory Middleware
nodes.description: Implements Anthropic's memory tool, managing memory files within the LangGraph state and enforcing a `/memories` path prefix.

nodes.label: Claude Filesystem Text Editor
nodes.title: Claude Filesystem Text Editor Middleware
nodes.description: Provides Anthropic's `text_editor` tool, storing file content directly on the local filesystem for external persistence.

nodes.label: Claude Filesystem Memory Tool
nodes.title: Claude Filesystem Memory Middleware
nodes.description: Implements Anthropic's memory tool, managing memory files on the local filesystem and enforcing a `/memories` path prefix.

nodes.label: Claude State File Search
nodes.title: Claude State File Search Middleware
nodes.description: Offers `glob_search` and `grep_search` tools to query virtual files stored within the agent's LangGraph state, specifically for Anthropic tools.

nodes.label: Anthropic Prompt Caching
nodes.title: Anthropic Prompt Caching Middleware
nodes.description: Optimizes API calls to Anthropic models by applying cache control breakpoints to system messages and tool definitions, reducing token usage.

nodes.label: OpenAI Content Moderation
nodes.title: OpenAI Moderation Middleware
nodes.description: Integrates OpenAI's moderation endpoint to check agent inputs, outputs, and tool results for policy violations, with configurable handling.

nodes.label: Base Chat Model
nodes.title: Base Chat Model
nodes.description: Abstract base class for chat-based language models, providing a common interface for LLM interactions.

nodes.label: Initialize Chat Model
nodes.title: Initialize Chat Model
nodes.description: Utility function to initialize a chat model instance from a model identifier string or configuration.

nodes.label: AI Message
nodes.title: AI Message
nodes.description: Represents a message generated by an AI model, often containing text content and tool calls.

nodes.label: Human Message
nodes.title: Human Message
nodes.description: Represents a message originating from a human user, typically containing text input to the agent.

nodes.label: Tool Message
nodes.title: Tool Message
nodes.description: Represents the output or result of a tool execution, providing feedback to the agent.

nodes.label: Base Tool
nodes.title: Base Tool
nodes.description: Abstract base class for tools that agents can use, defining their interface and functionality.

nodes.label: Tool Decorator
nodes.title: Tool Decorator
nodes.description: A decorator used to convert a Python function into a callable tool for agents.

nodes.label: Structured Tool
nodes.title: Structured Tool
nodes.description: A tool that expects structured input, often defined using Pydantic models, for more precise argument parsing.

nodes.label: System Message
nodes.title: System Message
nodes.description: Represents a system-level instruction or context provided to the AI model, guiding its behavior.

nodes.label: Anthropic Chat Model
nodes.title: Anthropic Chat Model
nodes.description: A specific implementation of a chat model interacting with Anthropic's API.

nodes.label: OpenAI Client
nodes.title: OpenAI Client
nodes.description: Client for interacting with OpenAI's API services.

nodes.label: Async OpenAI Client
nodes.title: Async OpenAI Client
nodes.description: Asynchronous client for interacting with OpenAI's API services.

groups.label: Execution Environment Control
groups.title: Execution Environment Control
groups.description: Middleware components that manage how external commands are executed, providing various levels of isolation and security.

groups.label: Conversation Context Management
groups.title: Conversation Context Management
groups.description: Components focused on optimizing and managing the agent's conversational context, including pruning and summarization.

groups.label: Tool Interaction & Reliability
groups.title: Tool Interaction & Reliability
groups.description: Middleware for enhancing how agents interact with tools, including emulation, retries, intelligent selection, and human oversight.

groups.label: Resource & Flow Limits
groups.title: Resource & Flow Limits
groups.description: Components that enforce limits on model and tool calls, manage fallbacks, and control the overall flow of agent execution.

groups.label: Data Privacy & Security
groups.title: Data Privacy & Security
groups.description: Middleware for detecting and handling sensitive information (PII) and moderating content for policy compliance.

groups.label: Task & Planning
groups.title: Task & Planning
groups.description: Components that enable agents to manage structured task lists and integrate planning capabilities into their workflow.

groups.label: Anthropic Specific Tooling
groups.title: Anthropic Specific Tooling
groups.description: Middleware providing specialized tools and optimizations tailored for Anthropic models, including state-based and filesystem-based file operations and prompt caching.

groups.label: Internal Utilities
groups.title: Internal Utilities
groups.description: Helper functions for wrapping middleware methods, ensuring consistent synchronous and asynchronous execution patterns.
